independentPinnedDictionaryLookup.method: Spylls Hunspell exact surface-form lookup against both previously pinned Portuguese dictionaries. The complete lookup table is retained privately and bound by its SHA-256. No dictionary suggestion generation was used.
independentPinnedDictionaryLookup.multiwordTargetDisposition: Exact whole-string Hunspell lookup does not tokenize phrases. All four flagged rules produce the three explicitly confirmed phrases com certeza, de repente and se calhar, supported by the targeted primary article.
independentPinnedDictionaryLookup.freshnessBoundary: The four exact files are pinned to the recorded LibreOffice repository commit, captured earlier in development. No refreshed-current-HEAD claim is made. The Brazilian file retains a version3.2/2013 header, which is a dictionary label rather than the capture date. Neither this lookup nor the dictionary proves contextual meaning or proper names.
independentPinnedDictionaryLookup.semanticClaim: No automatic source form was accepted by either pinned dictionary. This reduces a defined ambiguity risk, without proving every occurrence should be changed. Proper names, foreign-language text, quotations and source material require independent protection.
independentPinnedDictionaryLookup.independenceBoundary: The original catalog was also developed using these dictionaries. This is a new exact lookup independent of runtime transformation output, not a second independent lexical authority or a new manual semantic review of every mapping.
